christmas.public_note: Christmas needs its own expanded candidate pool. Do not fill Christmas with Thank You unless a specific gratitude fit is admin-approved.

new-year.public_note: New Year needs hope, fresh-start, reflection, and keep-going candidates. Do not fake-fill with unrelated audio.

easter.public_note: Easter needs renewal, hope, light, family, or faith-friendly spring candidates. Do not fake-fill with unrelated audio.

memorial-remembrance.public_note: Memorial / Remembrance needs grief comfort, honor, memory, and legacy candidates. Father’s Day queue contains one legacy idea, but no public-ready audio path yet.
